name: rans_static (rANS_static4x16, r32x16b_avx2 SIMD rANS experiments)
baseline: rANS_static4c (4-way interleaved scalar rANS, the CRAM variant) and arith_static (unrolled static arithmetic coder), both in the same repo
workload: Order-0 and order-1 static-model encode and decode of two DNA-sequencing quality-value files (Q8: 73,124,567 bytes; Q40: 94,602,182 bytes), single thread, reported in MB/s with compressed size.
claimed_speedup: Order-0 decode, gcc 6.2.0, Q8: r32x16b_avx2 1430.6 MB/s vs rANS_static4c 335.2 MB/s and arith_static 146.5 MB/s; Q40: 1415.0 MB/s vs 360.4 MB/s (rANS_static4c) and 144.0 MB/s (arith_static). Order-1 decode, gcc: Q8 1039.4 vs 280.7 MB/s, Q40 985.9 vs 204.5 MB/s (rANS_static4c). Scalar rANS_static4x16 order-0 decode 664.5 MB/s (Q8) vs 335.2 MB/s for rANS_static4c. Ratios of about 4.3x (Q8) and 3.9x (Q40) order-0 decode for r32x16b_avx2 over rANS_static4c are derived from page data. Encode is not much faster (534.7 vs 294.2 MB/s Q8 order-0).
compiler_and_flags: gcc 6.2.0, clang 3.7.0 and icc 15.0.0 (README); Makefile CFLAGS=-O3 -g -mtune=native -Wall, with BLK_SIZE 1013*1047 and NTRIALS=1 in DEFINES
hardware: Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-4570 CPU @ 3.20GHz (from /proc/cpuinfo, Ubuntu Trusty)
stars_or_usage: 92 stars; README points to samtools/htscodecs as the maintained successor
tradeoffs: Static (non-adaptive) order-0/1 models with a frequency table sent in the stream; 16-bit renormalisation and 32 interleaved states cost a little compression (Q8 order-0: 16,853,107 bytes for r32x16b_avx2 vs 16,850,374 for rANS_static4c). Needs AVX2 for the fast variants; the order-1 SIMD variants are described as non-functioning or not updated for some entries (r32x16_avx2 shows ERR for order 1). The author calls the SIMD codecs experimental with many warnings and commented-out code.
caveats: First-party numbers only. The Q8/Q40 test files are not shipped in the repo, so the run cannot be reproduced exactly (sample lines are shown in the README). The baselines are the author's own earlier rANS and arithmetic coder variants, not Huffman, FSE or ryg_rans itself, and no Huffman comparison exists. Compilers are old (gcc 6.2, clang 3.7) and the test CPU is a 2013 Haswell. No licence file: the code derives from ryg_rans (public domain) and Eugene Shelwein's coder, but the repo itself states no licence, so treat as reference only. The maintained and more aggressively SIMD-optimised successor htscodecs is already catalogued. Compiled AVX-512 variants exist in the source but are commented out of the Makefile and absent from the README results. Page content was read through WebFetch and the raw README, not rerun.
found_via: GitHub: WebSearch 'github rANS entropy coder library C++ header-only SSE AVX2 NEON throughput MB/s compared to FSE' surfaced the repo; README and Makefile opened via raw.githubusercontent.com, commits page via github.com/jkbonfield/rans_static/commits
